reg_identity_s0.doc: Straight walk; a second person crosses between robot and target.
Target walks straight; a second person walks towards the robot and passes 0.8 m to its left.
A second person walks ahead-right of the target, then turns right while the target turns left.
As side_by_side, but both people wear the same colour, so clothing colour cannot tell them apart.
Target walks straight past a second person who stands 0.7 m to the right of the path.

reg_solo_s0.doc: Target walks straight ahead at 0.3 m/s, then stops.
Target walks, stands still for 5 s, then walks again.
Target walks ahead, then turns about 60 deg to the left.
Straight walk; the detector sees nothing from t=10 s to t=14 s.
Target walks 3 m away at 0.4 m/s, turns round and walks 1.5 m back towards the robot, as a worker does to load the cart, then stands.
Target steps 1 m sideways (out of the camera's view at this range), then walks on.
Target walks 3 m at 0.4 m/s, turns 90 degrees left and walks 3 m more.
Target walks straight at 0.6 m/s for 10 s, then stops.
Target walks straight at 1.0 m/s (normal walking) for 8 s, then stops.
Target weaves 0.6 m left and right every 3 s while walking at 0.4 m/s.
